ext.description: Monitor Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI usage limits side by side in VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and VSCodium, with 5-hour and weekly quotas, reset times, and alerts.
cmd.refresh.title: Refresh Usage
cmd.openSettings.title: Open Settings
cmd.openMenu.title: Open Menu
cfg.displayMode.compact: Show the 5-hour usage and its reset time, e.g. 5h 7% (3h 12m)
cfg.displayMode.full: Show each window with its reset time, e.g. 5h 7% (3h 12m) · 7d 41% (2d 5h)
cfg.warningThreshold: Show an orange warning background at or above this usage (%)
cfg.errorThreshold: Show a red error background at or above this usage (%)
